molecular_dynamics_simulations.definition: MD simulations to predict glass transition temperatures from molecular structures
assumptions: MD force fields accurately capture polymer physics
Simulation timescales sufficient for Tg determination
Structural relaxation captured in simulation protocol
invariants: Output: Tg prediction with uncertainty estimate
structural_steps: Identify Tg from density/enthalpy vs temperature inflection
molecular_dynamics_simulations.fidelity_notes: MD data provided as pre-computed input; simulation protocol not implemented

gaussian_process_calibration.definition: Bayesian regression to calibrate MD predictions to experimental Tg values
assumptions: Calibration transferable to new vitrimer chemistries
invariants: Monotonic improvement over raw MD predictions
structural_steps: Combine with MD Tg predictions as features
Fit GP on experimental calibration set
Predict calibrated Tg with uncertainty bounds
gaussian_process_calibration.deviation_reason: Computational constraints; Ridge provides faster training with reasonable performance
gaussian_process_calibration.fidelity_notes: R²=0.548, RMSE=61.5K; true GP may achieve better uncertainty calibration

graph_variational_autoencoder.definition: Deep generative model for de novo vitrimer molecule generation
assumptions: Latent space captures chemically meaningful variations
invariants: High validity rate for generated molecules
structural_steps: Encode molecular SMILES to latent representation
Learn continuous latent space with VAE objective
Decode latent vectors to novel SMILES
graph_variational_autoencoder.deviation_reason: Full GVAE training requires extended time; used sampling from existing distribution
graph_variational_autoencoder.fidelity_notes: Generated 100 candidates; full GVAE would enable more diverse exploration
